newsitem.title: MOROCCO: U.N. Western Sahara envoy James Baker in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: U.N. Western Sahara envoy James Baker in Morocco.

text.p: U.N. special envoy for Western Sahara James Baker arrived in Morocco on Wednesday to start a a fact-finding trip on the disputed territory.
Baker told reporters at Rabat airport: "During this trip I will be primarily listening to all parties...I am here to listen."

The former U.S. Secretary of State was appointed by U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan last month to try to resolve the dispute over the former Spanish colony. It is claimed by Morocco while the Algerian-backed Polisario Front seeks independence there.
A ceasefire, monitored by a U.N. force, has held since September 1991 but plans for a U.N. referendum on the future of the territory have been stalled since January 1992 over who is eligible to vote.
